# File map

**Diataxis type:** reference (generated). Regenerate with ``pwsh scripts/generate-file-map.ps1`` after
adding, removing, or repurposing a source file - its ``// FILE-MAP:`` comment first line is the source of truth.

| File | Purpose |
|---|---|
| ``src/Genesis.Cli/Program.cs`` | CLI entry point — command surface, interactive spec/seed pickers, registry + archive bookkeeping, the completion banner. |
| ``src/Genesis.Core/Agent/AgentRunner.cs`` | agent mode core — the draft → validate → run → (repair spec on failure) loop behind `dps-nn create`, plus environment-error triage and error condensing for the LLM. |
| ``src/Genesis.Core/Agent/LlmSpecAuthor.cs`` | agent mode's ISpecAuthor over the ADR-005 LLM file contract — builds the draft/repair prompts from the spec-authoring guide + a verified example spec. |
| ``src/Genesis.Core/Cli/InteractiveSelection.cs`` | shared candidate-discovery + numbered-menu helpers behind the CLI's interactive spec/seed pickers. |
| ``src/Genesis.Core/Diagnostics/Doctor.cs`` | `dps-nn doctor` — checks every prerequisite the pipeline needs (SDK, dotnet-ef, scaffolder, LocalDB, templates, writable workspace, API key) and prints the fix for each one missing. |
| ``src/Genesis.Core/Llm/LlmBridge.cs`` | the ADR-005 LLM file contract — request/response files, automatic vs manual (exit-3) mode, schema-validated retries, hash-logged exchanges. |
| ``src/Genesis.Core/Llm/LlmModels.cs`` | which Claude model each LLM exchange uses — Sonnet for spec drafting/repair (reasoning), Haiku for bulk seed rows; both overridable via env. |
| ``src/Genesis.Core/Pipeline/ParallelEmit.cs`` | parallel-worker execution for the emission stages, plus the Bulgarian worker-name tagging used to disambiguate concurrent log lines. |
| ``src/Genesis.Core/Pipeline/Pipeline.cs`` | the pipeline engine — StageContext, the resumable StateStore, PipelineRunner (the stage loop + progress log), and the Proc external-process wrapper. |
| ``src/Genesis.Core/Spec/ProjectSpec.cs`` | the POCO object model mirroring spec.schema.json — every group (meta, models, identity, controllers, views, features, seeding...) as a C# type. |
| ``src/Genesis.Core/Spec/SpecLoader.cs`` | loads a project-spec.json file and validates it against spec.schema.json before returning a ProjectSpec. |
| ``src/Genesis.Core/Stages/BuildStages.cs`` | stages 3-5 — ScaffoldStage (dotnet new mvc + build), EmitModelsStage (models/DTOs/DbContext), IdentityStage (Identity scaffold, BG localization, roles + seed users). |
| ``src/Genesis.Core/Stages/EmitControllersViewsStage.cs`` | stage 6 — controllers from three provenances (scaffold+deviations, template, hand-written) plus their views; deviations applied as anchored regex transforms. |
| ``src/Genesis.Core/Stages/SeedStage.cs`` | stage 7 — LLM seed-row generation via symbolic refs, image sourcing (Pexels/Pixabay/Picsum/local pack), SeedData.cs emission, EF migration add + apply. |
| ``src/Genesis.Core/Stages/SpecStages.cs`` | stages 1-2 — SpecBuildStage (notes.md -> draft spec via LLM) and SpecExpandStage (deterministic feature + $variation:* expansion into the lock file). |
| ``src/Genesis.Core/Stages/VerifyAndReportStages.cs`` | stage 8 — VerifyStage, the blocking gate (build, EF migrate, boot, HTTP checks, English-leak scan); stage 9 — ReportStage (project-summary.json). |
| ``src/Genesis.Core/Util/DotnetHost.cs`` | sets DOTNET_ROOT from the `dotnet` on PATH so global tools launched by the self-contained dps-nn.exe find the runtime (what `dotnet run` does for its child). |
| ``src/Genesis.Core/Util/TemplateEngine.cs`` | the single Scriban rendering surface every stage emits code through, plus its helper functions that carry variation into every emitted file. |
| ``src/Genesis.Core/Variation/VariationResolver.cs`` | ADR-004 deterministic per-project variation — resolves the 11 style axes from SHA256(seed+axis); also resolves $variation:axis placeholders and seed-user passwords. |
